description:
Configure the 'SALESTEAM' campaign to integrate with an external CRM and a logging webhook. 

Navigate to the 'SALESTEAM' campaign detail view and configure the following settings:

1. **Web Form**: Set the URL to `https://crm.example.com/view?lead_id=--A--vendor_lead_code--B--`
2. **Web Form Target**: Set this to `_blank` (to open in a new tab).
3. **Dispo Call URL**: Set the URL to `https://api.middleware.com/log_call?phone=--A--phone_number--B--&status=--A--dispo--B--&agent=--A--user--B--`

Ensure you save your changes. The variable syntax (e.g., `--A--variable--B--`) must be entered exactly as shown.
